### Creating Your First Project

**Using the GUI:**
1. Weave launches automatically after installation
2. Enter your project name and select a location  
3. Click "Create Project"

**Using the CLI:**
```bash
# macOS/Linux
weave new MyProject ~/Projects/

# Windows  
weave new MyProject C:\Projects\
```
